era_created.label: Era Created
era_created.description: The era the wonder was created in

legacy_status.label: Legacy Status
legacy_status.description: Whether the wonder has a legacy bonus

acts_as_trade_source.label: Acts as Trade Source
acts_as_trade_source.description: When true, this wonder's tile counts as a city for trade-distance calculations — it serves as an origin and destination point for trade routes, just like a regular city.

node.label: Node
node.description: The node under the wonder — auto-synced from the map tile when the wonder is placed

effect_description.label: Effect Description
effect_description.description: The description of the wonder's mechanical effects

owner_nation.label: Owner
owner_nation.description: The nation that currently controls the wonder — auto-synced from map tile ownership

creator_nation.label: Creator
creator_nation.description: The nation that originally created the wonder

external_modifiers.label: Mechanical Modifiers
external_modifiers.description: The mechanical modifiers that affect the owner nation or its ruling character

_id.label: Item ID
_id.description: Stable identifier for change tracking across reorders

type.label: Type
type.description: The type of entity the modifier affects

modifier.label: Modifier
modifier.description: The modifier key (e.g. stat_gain_chance for characters, food_production for nations)

modifiers.label: Ongoing Modifiers
modifiers.description: Scope-based modifiers applied to the owner nation or its ruling characters. Use scope 'wonder_owner_nation' for nation effects, 'wonder_owner_characters' for ruling character effects.

_id.label: Item ID
_id.description: Stable identifier for change tracking across reorders

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: The scope this modifier applies to (e.g. wonder_owner_nation, wonder_owner_characters)

max_value.label: Max Value
max_value.description: Maximum value cap for this modifier

duration.label: Modifier Duration
duration.description: The duration of the modifier (-1 for permanent)
